scope: Local CPU feasibility only. No Cloudflare deployment or cloud measurements.

engine.backend: EIGEN CPU; USE_AVX2=0; no Metal or GPU
engine.selection: Pinned known release for reproducible CPU experiment, not a claim to be latest. Homebrew formula currently reports 1.18.2 but macOS arm64 bottles use METAL, so source-build was selected instead of a nonrepresentative GPU bottle.
engine.license: MIT except bundled third-party components with their own licenses

model.name: g170e-b10c128-s1141046784-d204142634
model.architecture: 10 blocks, 128 channels, extended-training network from 2020 g170 run
model.limitations: Old, small model chosen for CPU feasibility; measured low-visit search does not establish rank, production quality, or strength of modern larger models.

dependencies.libzip: Disabled with NO_LIBZIP=1; GTP, matches and analysis supported, writing self-play training data unavailable. GTP-driven self-play does not require training-data writer.

resolved_setup_failure: Initial CMake configuration supplied EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIRS only, but non-MSVC find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED) still required package metadata. Configuring and installing the header-only Eigen package into the temporary deps prefix resolved discovery.
resolved_protocol_assumptions: GTP startup needs logAllGTPCommunication, logSearchInfo and resignThreshold when allowResignation is present, even false. Added documented config keys after real startup errors.

The initial experiment incorrectly expected input ko recapture to fail. Actual GTP and JSON replay accept it via tolerant move handling; source confirms Search::makeMove and analysis replay use tolerant legality. Corrected experiment records acceptance, separately asserts legal search avoids recapture and analysis policy marks it -1, and verifies occupied-point input rejection.
protocol_caveats: KataGo explicitly does not claim named country rules exactly match official rules; chinese-ogs here is POSITIONAL ko, AREA scoring, suicide false, tax NONE, whiteHandicapBonus N, friendlyPassOk true.
Use the complete ordered move history, board dimensions, rules and komi for restoration, not a bare board snapshot. set_position intentionally loses ko/superko and capture history.
Actual tested replay interfaces accept immediate ko recapture. Successful play/query ingestion is NOT an authoritative legal-move validator; independent application legality is mandatory.
JSON analysis can warn and substitute nearest supported rules for an older model. A production adapter must reject or explicitly handle warnings rather than assume parity.
GTP two-pass final_score output is engine scoring evidence, not independent formal-rules certification or a dead-stone adjudication UI.
